verdict.rationale: Steel's first-party docs include a cookbook entry to "Expose a Steel browser to any MCP client" and a Claude Agent SDK integration that exposes a cloud browser as in-process MCP tools. This shows official MCP connectivity, but it reads as a recipe and SDK-embedded tools rather than a packaged, standalone or hosted MCP server. Missing for 10: a documented standalone or hosted official MCP server product, its tool list and setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
